core: Amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation control
name: Lipoprotein-signaling control of amyloid-beta and glial activation
rationale: All members concern amyloid-beta formation/clearance, glial (microglia, astrocyte) activation and related synaptic or clearance effects; unlike every confusable, the theme includes lipoprotein particle and oxidised-LDL signaling.

name: Erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members cover the erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage (erythrocyte and megakaryocyte differentiation, RUNX1 and TAL1-GFI1B control, platelet morphogenesis); the megakaryocyte/platelet arm separates it from the erythroid-only C1 and the myeloid-progenitor C2-C4.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment, entry and membrane fusion
rationale: Members describe virion attachment, receptor-mediated endocytosis and envelope-driven fusion for dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV; the confusables instead centre on entry regulation, virus transport and viral protein maturation.

name: Regulation of primary and precursor miRNA processing
rationale: All three members regulate pri- and pre-miRNA processing, whereas the confusables cover overall biogenesis, RISC silencing, miRNA decay or miRNA-controlled translation.

qualifier: disaccharide digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
name: Disaccharide metabolism and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover carbohydrate digestion, disaccharide catabolism/lactose synthesis and hexose transport including SGLT/GLUT defects; confusables instead feature galactose/fructose catabolism, urate transport or glycoside transport.

qualifier: cellular senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: p53-mediated senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are p53/p14ARF/p16INK4A pathways driving oncogene- and stress-induced senescence (SAHF, SASP) and p53-dependent PUMA/NOXA apoptosis; senescence distinguishes it from the apoptosis-execution and G2-checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: epigenetic silencing, imprinting and X inactivation
name: Protein and DNA methylation in epigenetic gene silencing
rationale: Members cover histone/protein lysine and arginine methylation, demethylation and DNA methylation with heterochromatin, imprinting and X inactivation; confusables emphasise CHD/NuRD remodeling, deacetylation or arginine-only methylation.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and RNA processing and decay
rationale: Members span mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination and mitochondrial mRNA processing, stability and catabolism; confusables instead cover mtDNA replication/repair or mitochondrial translation and ribosome assembly.

name: TNF-receptor and IKK-driven canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members regulate canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kappaB via TNFR1, CD40/TNFSF receptors, IKK recruitment and linear ubiquitination; confusables are lymphocyte-receptor, TLR/TRIF-TAK1 or sumoylation sets.

name: Inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of inositol phosphates and diphosphoinositol polyphosphates, unlike the PTEN/PI3K or nucleotide-phosphate confusables.

core: B cell development and antibody diversification
name: Antibody diversification, B cell development and CD4 T cell proliferation
rationale: Members cover B-lineage commitment, V(D)J recombination, somatic hypermutation and class switching, plus modules of dividing stimulated CD4 T cells, which none of the APOBEC/mismatch-repair/HIV confusables contain.

name: Bile acid synthesis from cholesterol with peroxisomal beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are cholesterol catabolism to bile acids via hydroxycholesterol routes plus peroxisomal pristanoyl-CoA oxidation; confusables emphasise bile acid transport/signaling, vitamin E or intestinal lipid absorption.

core: Plasma membrane amino acid and urate transport
qualifier: epithelial SLC carriers and inherited aminoacidurias
name: Epithelial amino acid and urate transport with inherited aminoacidurias
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated amino acid, cystine and urate/organic anion transport with their renal transport disorders; confusables cover organic cations, sugars or oligopeptides.

name: Regulation of ubiquitin-proteasome protein degradation
rationale: All members up- or down-regulate proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent catabolism (destabilization, autoubiquitination, UCH proteinases); confusables involve chaperone folding, degron rules, stress granules or ERAD.

name: Nucleosome assembly and remodeling in DNA replication and repair
rationale: Members concern nucleosome organization/disassembly, replication-dependent chromatin assembly and repair-dependent remodeling (incl. ADP-ribosylation, NER); confusables are BAF/NuRD/CHD6-9 and acetylation sets.

name: Ferroptosis and responses to ischemic and peroxide stress
rationale: Members cover responses to peroxide, hydroperoxide, H2S, ischemia and oxygen-glucose deprivation and regulation of ferroptosis, which the ROS-detox, nitrosative and respiration confusables lack.

name: Calcium-CaMK-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link postsynaptic calcium, CaMK/adenylate cyclase signaling and CREB/NPAS4 to LTP, LTD and memory; confusables are PKA/forskolin, structural plasticity, MECP2 or NMDA receptor sets.

name: Thiamine, riboflavin and coenzyme A metabolism with pyruvate dehydrogenase
rationale: Members cover thiamine, riboflavin and pantothenate/CoA metabolism and transport together with PDH-mediated pyruvate decarboxylation; confusables are fatty acid oxidation, cobalamin/biotin or NAD metabolism.

core: Cytosolic DNA sensing and interferon-beta regulation
qualifier: cGAS-STING, CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokines
name: cGAS-STING regulation of interferon-beta, CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokines
rationale: Members regulate cGAS/STING (incl. cGAMP import, TREX1), interferon-beta, CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine output; confusables centre on RIG-I/IRF3, TLR7/8/9 or broad interferon-stimulated genes.

name: Adherens junction assembly and epithelial apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover cadherin/calcium-dependent adherens junctions, apical junctions and apical-basal polarity; confusables emphasise desmosomes, cardiac adhesion, cadherin turnover or substrate migration.

name: Vascular smooth muscle migration, proliferation and vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate VSMC migration, chemotaxis, proliferation, matrix adhesion and vascular remodeling/wound healing; confusables focus on VSMC differentiation, phenotypic switching and apoptosis.

name: OTU deubiquitinase K48/K11 chain removal and PKR signaling
rationale: Members are OTU-family K48/K11 deubiquitination and its regulation plus PKR signaling and kinase restraint; PKR is what separates it from USP/metalloprotease/K63 confusables.

name: Neutrophil and T cell adhesion and extravasation across endothelium
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, integrin-mediated migration, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation; confusables are PECAM/shear-stress or monocyte-centred sets.

name: Regulation of metanephric kidney development and size
rationale: All three members regulate kidney/metanephros development and size, whereas confusables describe specific nephron, ureteric bud or proliferation steps.

name: Endoplasmic reticulum tubular network formation and organization
rationale: All members concern formation and organization of the tubular ER network; confusables are organelle transport, ER lipid transfer or Golgi traffic.
